Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine

Interface AIiActionSchedulingScope

All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionIdentifiable, eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionScope
public interface AIiActionSchedulingScope extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionScope
Mutable definition-time action schedule belonging to one execution scope. At execution start the entire plan freezes. After freeze no action, subtransaction, listener or dependency may be added. The executor can launch a separate new plan.
